Haynes pages state Ford Technical Service data and name the SNJB engine code for the 1.25 Duratec; the Haynes Mk VII 2013-2017 plan URL was not returned directly, only the index page. The single Israeli-market source (queenoftheroad.co.il) states an annual / 15,000 km cadence for 2012-2016 1.25 cars, which differs from the EU 20,000 km / 12 months plan; this must be verified, not assumed.
